name: 54301 · Green Bay, WI
findings: ZIP 54301 (Green Bay) has 146 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54301 (Green Bay) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 54301 (Green Bay) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
